mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month prior to the decision is associated with higher expected corporate borrowing costs, which suppresses equity valuation growth and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or flat during FEDFUNDS > 4% regime, with p-value > 0.05 in a two-tailed test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coinciding with a decline in UNRATE (unemployment) suggests strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and equity valuations, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: No significant correlation (p > 0.1) between labor strength signal and 60-day forward returns in out-of-sample tests.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDPC1 (real private demand) followed by a subsequent drop in INDPRO (industrial production) indicates cyclically-driven demand pull that temporarily boosts equity valuations, yielding positive 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases while INDPRO decreases in the same month
failure_condition: No significant return effect (t-test p > 0.05) when demand surge is not followed by production lag.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) accompanied by elevated HOUST (housing starts) signals supply-side constraints, which can lead to higher risk premia and negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls while HOUST rises in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or indistinguishable from baseline during supply contraction.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent declines in CPIAUCSL (inflation) over the prior 3 months indicate disinflation, lowering real policy rates implicitly and supporting equity valuation expansion, predicting positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite CPIAUCSL declining for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in UNRATE (unemployment) above 6% in the prior month is associated with increased market uncertainty and a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to risk aversion.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 6% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are non-negative during UNRATE > 6% regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both INDPRO and RSAFS (retail sales) suggest weakening economic momentum, which elevates volatility and produces negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive or statistically insignificant during multi-month declines in both proxies.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% combined with a rising UNRATE (unemployment) indicates a dual softening in monetary policy and labor market, which typically precedes negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls for 2 consecutive months and UNRATE rises in the same period
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when both conditions are met in out-of-sample tests.
